_meta.method: Labelled from the source PDFs only (rendered pages plus the text layer), without looking at pipeline output. Every value has page + verbatim evidence; judgement calls are in notes.
_meta.rules: Same field definitions as the extraction prompt. vendor_name lists accepted aliases; a list for any other field means the bill itself prints conflicting values and either reading is correct; null means the bill does not print the value.

01_us_en_electricity-gas_sdge.pdf.notes: The PDF is a 2-page guide wrapping bill pages 1-3 of 4; the numbered callouts (1-14) and the left-margin text are annotations, not bill values. Issue date = 'DATE MAILED' because the bill prints no other issue-date label. Address: the label is the bill's own 'SERVICE ADDRESS' line, verbatim ('SD' = San Diego). The header 'SERVICE FOR' block gives the same premises in full ('4800 ELECTRIC AVE, SAN DIEGO, CA 92129'), which also scores correct under the grader's 80% token rule (4/5 tokens). The mailing block '4800 ELECTRIC AVENUE ... 92129-2829' is the mailing address. Gas: the meter difference is 22 (volume units), times therm multiplier 1.033 = 23 therms; charges are per therm, so 23 therms. A rate change on day 27 splits the 'Gas Energy Charge' into two rows that each show 'Therms used 23' (26 of 32 days, 6 of 32 days). That is a proration of the same 23 therms, so not 46. The period is the overall 05/05-06/06. Usage history figures (41, 18 therms; 429, 505 kWh) are previous periods. The Account Summary's 'Total Amount Due $147.50' contradicts 'AMOUNT DUE $167.23' (a specimen typo) but does not affect any labelled field.

03_gb_en_electricity-gas_octopus-energy..notes: This is an annotated specimen: the dark side panels and callouts ('Billing Period', 'Supply Address', and so on) explain the bill and are not values. Issue date: p1 prints '(2nd June 2023)' and p3 prints '(1st June 2023)' for the same bill reference. 2 June is labelled because p1 is the bill's own header, and because the bill uses customer readings dated 2nd June 2023, so it cannot have been issued on 1 June. The grader does an exact match, so 2023-06-01 will score wrong. Address: the specimen supply address is the 2nd floor of Octopus's own building. It is labelled 'Supply Address', so it counts. Octopus's registered/trading office ('UK House, 5th floor, 164-182 Oxford Street, London, W1D 1NN') is a different address and scores only 9/12 tokens (fails). The billing address on p1 is the same premises. Period: the p1 statement header '18th May 2023 - 1st June 2023' is the account balance period. The per-fuel charge periods are '17th May 2023 - 1st June 2023' (16 days, matching the '16 days' standing charges and the p3 averages 76.4/16 = 4.77 and 72.8/16 = 4.55 kWh/day), so those are used. The meter read dates (17 May / 2 Jun) are not used because a period is printed. Gas is printed as 6.4 m3 and 72.8 kWh; charges are per kWh, so 72.8 kWh. 'Estimated Annual Usage' (3923.8 kWh, 7766 kWh) is not billed usage. | invoice_date accepts both: the specimen prints 'Bill Reference: 145777963 (2nd June 2023)' on p1 and '(1st June 2023)' on p3.

08_br_pt_electricity_enel-ceara.pdf.notes: WARNING, two different bills on PDF page 3. The VISIBLE bill (what renders/prints) is an Enel Ceará (Companhia Energética do Ceará) Grupo A bill for 08/2018; labels follow it. Underneath it, fully hidden by a white rectangle plus two raster images (verified from PyMuPDF draw order; removing the image does not reveal it either), the TEXT LAYER also contains an older Enel Goiás bill (CNPJ 01.543.032/0001-04, 'Aplicativo Enel Goiás') with different values: 'EMISSÃO 07/07/2018', 'MÊS DE REFERÊNCIA 07/2018', 'DATA DA LEITURA ANTERIOR 04/06/2018' / 'ATUAL 04/07/2018' / 'NÚMERO DE DIAS 30', 'CONSUMO P 27,3' + 'CONSUMO FP 10332' + 'CONSUMO HR 19670,16' = 30029.46 kWh, address 'ZONA RURAL CEP: 00.000-000 CIDADE GO BRASIL'. A text-only extractor sees both interleaved and may legitimately return the hidden values (2018-07-07, 2018-06-04..2018-07-04, 30029.46 kWh). The source URL ('Entenda_sua_conta_ce_grandesclientes.pdf', 'ce' = Ceará) and p9 'App Enel Ceará' confirm the visible bill is the intended one, so SOURCES.md / the filename ('enel-goias', 'reference month 07/2018') describe the hidden layer, not the printed bill. Pages 4-8 are explanation pages, not repeats of the bill (their text layers duplicate the Goiás explanation text). Usage = Fora Ponta + Ponta (Reservado 0); demand kW and reactive energy excluded. Billing period from read dates (only read dates printed). | HIDDEN TEXT LAYER: under white rectangles the PDF text layer also holds an older Enel Goias bill (issued 07/07/2018, reads 04/06-04/07/2018). Labels follow the visible Enel Ceara bill, which is what a person sees.

Unit as printed is 'Megalitre' (canonical 'ML'); if the pipeline converts water to m3 the equivalent is 100000 m3. Vendor: charges are levied by the NSW Office of Water (letterhead, ABN) and billed/collected by State Water Corporation as agent; both accepted, plus 'Department of Primary Industries' from the letterhead; IPART (regulator) is not the vendor. Service address: no supply/property address on a water access licence bill; the only customer address printed (account + mailing, identical) is used per the fallback rule; the WAL water source 'Castlereagh River Above Binnaway Water Source' is an alternative reading but is not an address. Text layer repeats each glyph ~13x (overprint); de-duplicated it matches the visible bill exactly, no conflicting values.
